name: Satan
source:
The most violent out of the seven kings of Hell.

He is moody due to his depression and the devils around Satan are kicked out and sometimes fly away.

The devils of Gehenna enjoy being hit by Satan and sometimes hover around him on purpose.

Although he is a king, he is a king who is friends with all his citizens as he drinks and stays the night with low-class devils at a pub in the narrowest and most remote alley.

Likes beating and being beaten. But all those who experienced Satan's techniques set themselves up to be an M.
